name: Mandatory activation of segwit deployment
summary: A User-Activated Soft Fork (UASF) that forced SegWit activation by rejecting non-signaling blocks after a specific date. This was the community's response to miners refusing to signal for SegWit, demonstrating the power of users in Bitcoin governance.
summaryZh: 用户激活软分叉（UASF），通过在特定日期后拒绝不发送信号的区块来强制激活隔离见证。这是社区对矿工拒绝发送 SegWit 信号的回应，展示了用户在比特币治理中的力量。
